fact: At end October 2024 seven ECOWAS states running ASYCUDA World were linked to the SIGMAT transit-data platform, and for Cabo Verde the SIGMAT mobile version was judged the best fit, following an ECOWAS mission of 18-21 November 2024.
title: Direção Geral das Alfândegas recebe missão da CEDEAO para implementação do Sistema SIGMAT
publisher: Direção Nacional das Receitas de Estado, Ministério das Finanças
